study: Runner entry filter: does an entry-time trait, chosen from earlier studies, keep the runner's big winners while dropping enough of its losers to make the runner profitable? Operator 2026-10-15 after the right-tail runner FAIL (tail real: top 5% of runner trades +3,300 bp per half; the rest lose more).
registered_at: 2026-10-15 ~04:10 ET (commit 02a7651, 04:13), before any filtered return was computed. The runner's unfiltered result (FAIL) has been seen; no filtered split has.

filters_and_sources.F1_room: price at entry <= 97.26% of the day's SIP high so far (09:30 .. entry minute - 1). Source: name_selection_study 9/25 - room below HOD <= -2.74% was the only name input that lifted the mean in both halves.
filters_and_sources.F2_price50: entry price >= $50. Source: steady_runway_study 9/29 - steady +5% climb vs steady -5% fall best above $50 (1.42% vs 0.24%).
filters_and_sources.F3_early_up: day change at entry > +2.35% vs the prior raw SIP close AND entry 09:30-10:46 ET. Source: steady-runway 60-day check - 'up > 2.35% + first 76 min' 4.5% vs 3.0% steady climbs.

trades_and_exit: Exactly right_tail_runner.py: first fill per name-day 2026-09-08..10-13, runner = 2% stop, 1% trail after +1%, graded worse bar ordering, 15:49 close; cost 5 bp + the measured live stop/trail slippage on stop/trail exits.
statistic: Per filter and half: kept-trade runner net (day-equal mean, day-clustered t); lift = kept mean - all-trades mean per day (same day), day-equal and t.
pass: A filter PASSES only if, POOLED over the 26 sessions: kept runner net > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2.4, lift >= +10 bp with t >= 2.4, >= 60 kept trades and >= 15% of trades with a known trait; AND in EACH half the kept net and the lift are > 0 (same sign, no t bar per half). Otherwise FAIL (UNDERPOWERED when the size floors fail). PLUS a concentration check (skeptic round 1 #3): the kept net and the lift must stay > 0 after dropping the kept set's top 3 days, top 5 names and top 5 trades (each separately). A PASS is a CANDIDATE only: F2's kept trades are mostly half B, so the same-sign halves are weak replication.
no_retuning: Thresholds 97.26%, $50, +2.35% / 10:46, the runner exit and the costs are fixed. Combinations of filters are not graded (a combination is a new prereg on new sessions).
if_pass: Forward confirmation on sessions after 2026-10-15: accumulate kept trades until >= 100 (at ~3 kept per day, ~6 weeks; faster on the simulator once unlocked), then kept runner net > 0 with t >= 2 and lift > 0; then a result-skeptic review. A live runner tag also needs the trait computed on the live IEX feed (HOD, prior close and the runner path are SIP here).
if_fail: None of the three name traits rescues the runner; next: earnings-gap continuation (different structure) rather than more filters on these trades.
power_note: ~170 / 262 first fills per half; a 25-40% keep leaves ~40-100 trades on 13 days per half - only a large effect can reach t 2.4.
data_note: Prior close = the raw SIP close of the session IMMEDIATELY before the trade day (hist_universe daily cache, ends 2026-10-09). 10/13 entries (prior session 10/12 missing from the cache) and names without a row are F3-unknown and excluded from F3's known count (counted). SPY beta of the kept set is not reported (SPY minute bars are not in this cache); F3's up-day lean is a stated caveat.
amended: 2026-10-15 ~04:15 ET (commit e0d3c619), before any return: the inventory (counts only) showed every filter below the per-half floors in one half (F1 B 31 kept / 12%, F2 A 25 / 15%, F3 B 51 / 20%), so the per-half rule could only read UNDERPOWERED. Graded pooled instead, with a same-sign condition in each half; floors 60 kept and 15% share. Thresholds, traits, exit and costs unchanged.
prior: LOW.
